description_en: Uploads data in parts based on the specified object name and upload ID
description_zh: 根据指定的Object名和uploadId来分块（Part）上传数据
name: UploadPart

parameters.description_en: The full path of the object.
parameters.help_en: The full path of the object
parameters.name: key

parameters.description_en:
The number that identifies each uploaded part (part number).

Valid values: 1 to 10000.

The size of a single part is limited to 100 KB to 5 GB.
>In a multipart upload event, all parts except the last part must be greater than or equal to 100 KB. Because it is uncertain whether a part is the last one, the UploadPart operation does not immediately verify the size of the uploaded part. The size is verified only when CompleteMultipartUpload is called.
parameters.description_zh:
每一个上传的Part都有一个标识它的号码（partNumber）。

取值：1~10000

单个Part的大小限制为100 KB~5 GB。
>MultipartUpload事件中除最后一个Part以外，其他Part的大小都要大于或等于100 KB。因不确定是否为最后一个Part，UploadPart接口并不会立即校验上传Part的大小，只有当CompleteMultipartUpload时才会校验。
